name: November 6, 2025 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  HARRY BAROVSKY MEMORIAL YOUTH COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  7:00 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Commissioner O. Porat called the meeting to order at 7:01 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Commissioners Charlotte Bonnici, Max Graulich, Oscar Johnson, Danae
  Jones, Parker Kaplan, Jacob Koziatek, Kailyn Lilly, Preston Lilly, Shiloh Magna, Xue
  Mastrippolito, Rayan Mirmohammadsadeghi, Hayden Morra, Kylie Morra, Taylor
  Murray, Darcy O’Herlihy, Cole Ovsiowitz (arrived at 7: l 5 p.m.), Grayson Polatin, Presley
  Polatin, Eden Porat, Ore Porat, and Nikau Webb

  ABSENT: Commissioners Anniston Aragon, Kane Bendler, Christopher Hilling, Sofia
  Myers, and Stash Wolski

  ALSO PRESENT: Bryce Woodbury, Interim Recreation Coordinator, and Kate Manisco,
  Recreation Manager

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Kaplan led the Pledge ofAllegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner P. Polatin moved, and Commissioner O’Herlihy seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 20-0.
  Commissioners Aragon, Bendler, Hilling, Myers, Ovsiowitz, and Wolski absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Recreation Manager Manisco reported the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  October 3 l , 2025.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC AND
  COMMISSIONERS
   Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 6, 2025
  Page 2 of 5

  Councilmember Haylynn Conrad welcomed the Commissioners to the 2025-26
  appointment term and thanked them for their dedication and service to the Malibu
  community.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Webb moved, and Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi seconded
  a motion to approve the consent calendar. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 20-0. Commissioners Aragon, Bendler, Hilling, Myers, Ovsiowitz, and
  Wolski absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval ofMinutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the September 4, 2025,
  Youth Commission Regular meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Youth Government Summit Series

  Recommended Action: Provide feedback on the topics and representatives for the
  Youth Government Summit Series.

  Recreation Manager Manisco presented the staff report.

  Chair Porat recommended a Park Ranger with experience from the Malibu region.

  Commissioner Webb suggested a speaker with expertise in environmental
  sustainability, resilience, or coastal preservation.

  Commissioner O’Herlihy suggested Los Angeles County Board of Supervisor,
  Lindsey P. Horvath, or an office representative.

  Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi recommended a college admissions
  counselor.
   Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Minutes ofNovember 6, 2025
  Page 3 of 5

  Health and Wellness Program

  Recommended Action: Provide feedback on the Health and Wellness Program.

  Recreation Manager Manisco presented the staff report.

  Commissioner K. Morra suggested fitness classes or a virtual presentation on the
  importance of fitness.

  Commissioner Magna recommended a yoga class.

  Commissioner Kaplan supported a run club or a run meet-up at a local park.

  Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi suggested a program with therapy dogs.

Commissioner Ovsiowitz arrived at 7:15 p.m.

  C.  Skate Park Grand Opening

  Recommended Action: Provide feedback on the event elements related to the
  Skate Park opening celebration.

  Recreation Manager Manisco presented the staff report.

  Commission O’Herlihy suggested non-local food vendors and professional skating
  demonstrations.

  Commissioner Kaplan recommended partnering with local skate businesses to
  provide merchandise giveaways.

  Commissioner Ovsiowitz recommended a raffle for merchandise giveaways.

  Commissioner Koziatek suggested a partnership with the Malibu Boys & Girls
  Club and the Johnny Strange Foundation.

  Commissioner Magna supported a skateboarding art activity with custom shirts and
  hats.

  Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi recommended a giveaway supply bag for
  new skaters, which would include wax and safety equipment.

  Regular Meeting Schedule
   Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission
  Regular Mecting
  Minutes ofNovember 6, 2025
  Page 4 of 5

  Recommended Action: Review and approve the Regular and Special meeting
  schedule for the 2025-26 appointment year.

  Recreation Manager Manisco presented the staff report.

MOTION  Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi moved, and Commissioner O’Herlihy
  seconded a motion to cancel the January l, 2026, and April 2, 2026 Regular
  meetings, and schedule Special meetings for January 8, 2026, and April l6, 2026.
  The question was called, and the motion carried 21-0. Commissioners Aragon,
  Bendler, Hilling, Myers, and Wolski absent.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Recreation Manager Manisco thanked Commissioners Bonnici, Jones, Kaplan,
  Magna, H. Morra, K. Morra, Murray, Myers, O’Herlihy, Ovsiowitz, E. Porat, and
  O. Porat for their recent volunteer work at City special events.

  Recreation Manager Manisco provided an update on upcoming volunteer
  opportunities and donation drives, including Santa Paws, Breakfast with Santa,
  Zuma Beach Clean-Up Day, and Toy Donation Drive benefiting the Los Angeles
  County Firefighters Foundation.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS, AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner O’Herlihy inquired about the Executive Board nomination process
  and the election timeline. Recreation Manager Manisco will review the Resolution
  and provide a staff update at a future meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  None.

ADJOURNMENT

MOTION  At 7:27 p.m., Commissioner Mirmohammadsadeghi moved, and Commissioner
  Kaplan seconded a motion to adjourn the meeting. The question was called, and the
  motion carried 21-0. Commissioners Aragon, Bendler, Hilling, Myers, and Wolski
  absent.
